messages:
nina_support: Hey, we've got an escalation from a customer — their Service Metrics panel (service=payments) shows p50 and throughput fine but p95/p99 lines are missing after last night's router cutover. Anyone else seeing this? :thinking:

mike_sre: Noted. Can you share the org id and a quick screenshot? Is this across multiple orgs or just one tenant?

nina_support: Reported for 3 orgs so far: org-781, org-982, org-120. Screenshot attached in ticket SUP-33421. Time range: 24h window; p95 was present before the cutover.

liam_platform: I saw the deploy-bot entry for the router cutover at 2024-11-12T02:03Z — we also flipped the metric tag remap flag (split-tenant-by-org). Might be related.

mike_sre: I tried to repro on staging by enabling the remap flag. Dashboard queries that look for "latency.p95" return empty, while the pipeline now emits "latency.quantile.q95" series. Looks like a rename in the transform.

nina_support: Quick customer workaround: asked them to switch the panel "metric selector" to the "legacy tags" option — they reported p95 reappeared briefly.

mike_sre: Thanks, that confirms a naming mismatch. Two options: update dashboard queries to the new metric names, or add compatibility aliases in the ingest/collector so old selectors still match. Aliasing seems safest short-term.

liam_platform: I'll review the router/transform commits and the flag flip history. If we can patch an alias at the router layer with minimal risk we can avoid editing many dashboards.

deploy-bot: canary cutover completed on 2024-11-12T02:03Z by liam_platform. Flag split-tenant-by-org=true.

mike_sre: Repro steps for ENG (quick):
```bash
# example queries against internal metrics API
curl -s 'https://metrics.internal/api/query?metric=latency.p95&service=payments&org=org-781' # returns empty
curl -s 'https://metrics.internal/api/query?metric=latency.quantile.q95&service=payments&org=org-781' # returns series
```

mike_sre: I'm assigning to liam_platform to evaluate an ingest alias hotfix. If aliasing won't work we may need a rollback. I'll stand by to open an incident if needed.

liam_platform: Quick investigation: transform step "quantile->quantile.qXX" drop happened in the tag-remap stage; dashboards that use old metric names won't match. I'm preparing a canary patch to map latency.p95 -> latency.quantile.q95 and same for q99.

liam_platform: Patch applied to canary at 2024-11-12T02:47Z — canary panels show p95/p99 restored. Rolling to prod next (15m window).

nina_support: Customer for org-781 just confirmed p95 is visible again :tada:. Updating SUP-33421 and telling the other two orgs the fix is rolling.

mike_sre: Keeping this open until prod roll completes and until we ship a follow-up: docs update + console UI note recommending metric-name migration. Also need a postmortem on feature-flag gating for transforms.

liam_platform: Prod roll finished at 2024-11-12T03:05Z, aliasing live. I'll post PR with exact change and test matrix.

nina_support: Noted. Ticket SUP-33421 updated with timeline and workaround. Thanks everyone.
